summary.text: Chris Glassburn is a Democratic state representative from Ohio who has represented District 15 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a small business owner and former North Olmsted city councilman.

paragraphs.text: Chris Glassburn was born in Painesville, Ohio, and earned a bachelor's degree in history from Baldwin Wallace College.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working as a small business owner and serving on the North Olmsted City Council and the North Olmsted School Board.
Glassburn assumed office in the Ohio House on January 1, 2025, and is ranking member of the Energy Committee and a member of the Public Insurance and Pensions Committee.
He was unopposed in the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Daniel Conway in the general election.
